title: Retail acceptance mark
slide_intent: Show recognition at the point of purchase because a payment identity must signal where a service is available.
strategic_value: A compact acceptance mark can carry practical meaning within an everyday scene.
demonstration: A family sits outside a shop; a vertical payment-sticker group appears on the glass at right.
practical_value: Inspect the mark at incidental scale beside other payment brands.
